clean_repro.probe: Create collection 'test_dup', then create same collection 'test_dup' again
clean_repro.observed: Both create operations succeeded with HTTP 200, violating uniqueness constraint. Second create should have returned 400 for duplicate name.
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: Verified via output_milvus_50321.log - POST /collections/create with collectionName='test_dup' executed twice, both returned {"code":0,"data":{}}

contract_refs: constraint_id: milvus_state_collections_create_001 - assertion: 'collectionName is unique within dbName'
assertion_id: milvus_behavioral_collections_create_002 - expected: 'returns 400 on duplicate collection name'

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: HandlersV2.createCollection() → schema validation → shard/consistency processing → wrapperProxyWithLimit() → NO duplicate name pre-check → creates duplicate collection
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:REST v2 createCollection handler (handler_v2.go:1795-2030) 仅验证请求参数合法性(schema/dimension/type)，未检查 collectionName 是否已存在于该 database 中。根据契约 milvus_state_collections_create_001 要求 'collectionName is unique within dbName' 且 behavioral assertion milvus_behavioral_collections_create_002 明确期望 'returns 400 on duplicate name'，但源码无此预检查。

falsification.probe: Verify that uniqueness is a legitimate requirement by checking other similar endpoints
falsification.observed: Other create endpoints (databases+create, users+create, roles+create, aliases+create, partitions+create) explicitly document '400 if already exists' in contract, confirming uniqueness is standard expectation

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API fails to properly serialize/deserialize complex data types - 26 historical instances, high confidence (0.95)
cognition_match.note: 虽然 bug_shapes 显示 REST v2 存在系统性问题，但本案例是唯一性校验缺失而非类型序列化。不过这进一步证实 REST v2 层存在系统性验证缺失问题。

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 collections+create 允许创建同名 collection，违反契约 milvus_state_collections_create_001 明确要求的 'collectionName is unique within dbName' 约束及 behavioral assertion milvus_behavioral_collections_create_002 期望的 'returns 400 on duplicate name' 行为。源码接地确认 handler_v2.go:1795-2030 中的 createCollection() 函数仅验证参数合法性，未检查 collectionName 是否已存在。实测复现确认：对同一 collectionName 执行两次 create 均成功返回 HTTP 200。其他 create endpoints (databases/users/roles/aliases/partitions) 的契约均明文规定重复返回 400，证明唯一性检查是标准预期。非平凡解释已排除。属真缺陷：唯一性校验缺失导致 API 违反其明文契约。
